verdict.rationale: Stripe's Shared Payment Token explicitly supports amount, currency, and expiration limits plus per-seller scoping and revocation, and Link CLI issues one-time-use virtual cards/SPTs approved per-request by the customer — directly matching the amount/expiry/merchant-restriction ask. Caveats: ACS/SPT is private preview, geographically limited (US/Canada/select EU), and a community comment flags sparse end-to-end documentation on how SPT mechanics actually resolve, and the virtual-card credential type is explicitly NOT merchant-restricted (works anywhere). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of SPT enforcement in production, broader GA availability, and clearer end-to-end docs on credential resolution.
